t: Hon Thom Cable Car (2026 Reviews) - All You Need to Know BEFORE You Go
s: Its completely different then the cable car at Sun World Ba Na Hills as that one takes you to the mountains while this one is over the sea. The sights from the cable car were to die for and our guide helped us identify islands we would later visit for snorkeling. You cant buy tickets only for the cable car - they come in a package which includes entry to Sun World Hon Thom.
